title: The End
summary: The three new outer-End biomes, Starstone and Astral Crystals, the Astral Observatory dungeon, and where the Ender Wyrm is fought.

s.x: Astral Fields give the easiest Astral Shards: wander the fields with a pickaxe and break every crystal you see. The Star Warden also drops 8 to 14 shards on each kill.

A purpur and glass observatory on stilts, found on the outer islands in all five of the biomes above (the vanilla highlands and midlands too). Inside are star-map halls, archives and telescope rooms. It is a level 64 dungeon in two floors: the Lower Halls, then a 20-block climb up to the Star Deck. See

Blinks, fires volleys of starlight and slams. Below 66% it pulls players in and summons Acolytes and Void Mites. Below 50% it wards, and below 33% it sends shockwaves and enrages.
